verdict.rationale: The evidence offers only a thin deletion control: secure shredding of physical mail is included. Retention is described only as vendor-set defaults (unlimited cloud storage for scans, physical mail held 30 days for letters and 10 for packages), not as settings the user controls. Missing for 10: user-configurable retention periods, deletion of digitized scans and account data, API or programmatic deletion, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
